## Summary
AUMOVIO SE is the former Automotive group of Continental AG: the name was announced on 23 April 2025, the spin-off completed in September 2025 with a Frankfurt listing (ticker AMV0) at a valuation of about 4.1 billion, and the company is headquartered in Frankfurt [1][2]. Continental's US automotive electronics arm, Continental Automotive Systems - itself built on Motorola's automotive electronics unit (2006) and Siemens VDO (2007) - moved to AUMOVIO in that spin-off [2][3]. The IEEE lists "AUMOVIO Systems, Inc." blocks at 21440 W. Lake Cook Rd., Deer Park, Illinois (D4:94:FB, 00:54:AF, 20:AD:56, 34:22:CF, 00:1E:AE) and 3901 North First Street, San Jose, California (8C:5F:48), alongside sister entities in Germany, France, Romania, Czechia, Hungary, Malaysia and Brazil listed above as affiliates [7]. A MAC in these blocks is a vehicle electronics unit: AUMOVIO's connectivity line includes telematics for heavy-duty vehicles and infotainment boxes for two-wheelers [5], and its access line is keyless entry and digital keys (PASE, CoSmA) [4]; the vendor pages reached name no radio technology for any of these, so what such a unit emits on the air - and which chipsets sit inside it - is not documented here. FCC databases refused automated access, so no grantee code is confirmed. An NVD keyword search for "Continental Automotive" returned zero CVEs [6]. MAC randomization behaviour is not documented.
